definition: Where the survey image of NGC 1275 fades into its sky, measured here on the cleaned cutout in 10 arcsec elliptical annuli: 200 arcsec along the major axis, 66.6 kpc at 68.7 Mpc. Not a published size of the galaxy.
presentation: Where the volume ends: while the camera is inside this radius the galaxy's caption hides; outside it the caption hangs under what is drawn of the galaxy. Not a boundary of the galaxy.
